auditable connection from the bound cache rows or original batch to that mapping
same-contract basis for proposed WI/regular continuity if such use is requested

dependency_scope.required_proof: Pre-performance evidence that frozen isolation leaves every necessary training/label/admission/reference/action/valuation/continuous-state path calculable; otherwise submit actual minimal fields/symbols/windows. Null outputs alone do not pass the minimum set.
dependency_scope.R2: Stop indeterminate necessary formal path; preserve folds, dates, attempts, N and budget. No fold skipping, capital reset or valid-slice splice.

handoff: Record S4 field-scope and required dependency evidence in the existing minimum-set/engineering lines; do not duplicate work or treat research acceptance as runtime release.
